notes:
Context: mid-market product analytics SaaS that provides semantic search over customer docs and feature telemetry. Primary aim is to move embeddings + search from slow SQL matches to vector-backed relevance for support search + in-app recommendations. Evaluating Redwood hosted first (fast time-to-value) then a Dedicated reserved pool for production throughput and cost predictability.

Technical constraints / requirements:
- Corpus ~1.2M short docs and 3M short metadata rows; nightly batch embedding job (~50K-200K vectors/day depending on workload).
- Production search SLA: top-k semantic query 95th percentile <100ms (prefer <50ms for interactive flows).
- Vector dimension target: 1536 (using open embedding models); prefer open models or supply own fine-tuned model later.
- Integration: currently prototyping with Pinecone; also evaluating pgvector for lower-cost archival queries. Need guidance on connector patterns and cold-start costs.
- Cost sensitivity: mid — willing to commit for Dedicated if unit token/embedding costs + autoscale math show 30-40% savings vs hosted at projected volume.
- Security: must pass SOC2 checklist, require SSO/SAML + audit logs + KMS for key separation, and data residency locked to us-east.
- Ops: need tooling for batch job retries, idempotent embedding runs, delta-embedding strategies, and dedup handling.

Quotes from stakeholders:
- "We need sub-100ms for 95th percentile — if not, users will complain." — Head of Product
- "If Redwood can show a clear Dedicated ROI at our volumes we can move to reserved capacity by Q2." — VP Engineering

POC scope & success criteria:
- Validate hosted API can sustain nightly batch embed jobs and interactive search SLA with our dataset (pass: 95th pctl <100ms and throughput >=50K/day).
- Confirm integration pattern with Pinecone + ability to fall back to pgvector for cold queries.
- Receive formal Dedicated pricing (monthly commit tiers) and quantization recommendations for cost/latency tradeoffs.
